summary: This bill expands the types of land eligible for continuous enrollment in the Conservation Reserve Program (CRP), allows emergency haying during the primary nesting season under certain drought or disaster conditions, provides cost-sharing for grazing infrastructure, clarifies management payment eligibility, and increases the payment limit for CRP rental payments.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) to allow for cost-sharing payments for grazing infrastructure and increases the payment limitation for rental payments from $50,000 to $125,000. These changes will likely lead to increased federal outlays for the CRP, thus increasing government spending.
